headline: One intake, all your plates.
description: Photo radar and red-light camera notices for Alberta fleets. One account contact, a clear decision on each ticket, and less administration for your team.

steps.title: Introduce your fleet
steps.description: Complete one account intake with your business, plates and expected ticket volume. Fabsy confirms the account and secure notice-upload arrangements.

steps.title: We review each notice
steps.description: For each accepted owner notice, Fabsy enters the not-guilty plea, requests disclosure and pursues a Crown reduction or withdrawal. No trial and no success fee.

steps.title: You approve; we invoice
steps.description: Your authorized account contact approves any deal for each ticket. Arrange a monthly QuickBooks invoice for an approved fleet account.

accountPricing: Account pricing is available at 5+ tickets per month. Fabsy confirms the rate and monthly invoicing terms before work begins; no volume discount is applied automatically.
